review: Listen — I am Adventist, third generation, and I have spent my whole life explaining to people why I am not available on a Saturday. "Open the Calendar" is the first piece of music I have found that treats the appointed times as a gift instead of a peculiarity. I nearly cried at a bus stop. My grandmother is Kingston-born and it was her Sabbath before it was mine and she would have loved this and she is gone. I play it in my classroom during independent work and thirty ninth-graders a period hear it without anybody calling it worship, which is exactly how I want it.
